businesses.business: domain registration and small-business web services

offering_description.value: Sells domain names, web hosting, website builders, email and security products, and commerce and payment tools to small businesses, entrepreneurs and individuals. Delivers them as cloud-based subscriptions through its websites and apps, with customer support and some done-for-you services.

primary_products.value: domain names; web hosting; website builder; email and productivity subscriptions; website security and SSL certificates

primary_services.value: domain registration; managed WordPress hosting; payment processing; online marketing tools; website design services

customer_segment.value: B2B: small businesses, entrepreneurs, web professionals and domain investors; B2C: individuals and hobbyists registering domains and building personal sites

end_markets.value: small business web presence; e-commerce; domain aftermarket; web development agencies

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring domain, hosting, website, email and security plans; transaction or usage fees: payment processing fees and domain aftermarket transactions; service fees: done-for-you website and marketing services
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud hosting and website tools built in-house, sold to small businesses; service provider: registrar reselling domains from registries to customers

geography_served.value: global: customers in the US, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, India and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: domains, hosting, websites, security and commerce tools for small businesses

distribution_channels.value: online: own websites and mobile apps with self-service purchasing; direct sales: phone and chat customer care sales teams; partners / resellers: web professionals and reseller program

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: domain registrar accreditation by ICANN, data privacy rules like GDPR and CCPA, payments regulation
